chunks.title: About Us
chunks.text:
Faculty
The long-term growth and sustainable development of nations highly depend on the professional excellence of its individuals. Human resources can perform excellently only if their capabilities are developed, continuously upgraded, and they are sufficiently motivated to work both individually and collectively for the welfare of society. This can only occur in the presence of an inclusive, vibrant, dynamic, and competitive higher education system that meets both national and international standards of excellence and practice. Universities’ contributions go beyond traditional academic roles, profoundly impacting economic, social, and environmental dimensions.

chunks.title: About Us
chunks.text: Lahore Garrison University (LGU) envisions a research-driven and demand-oriented future by providing quality education to ensure a sustained supply of talented graduates with strong leadership and entrepreneurial skills. Our university takes pride in fostering strong character development grounded in ethical and moral values. The diversity and depth of our academic programs, along with the multidisciplinary nature of our applied research, inspire creative, imaginative, and innovative insights that offer solutions to real-world problems. We are committed to making a meaningful impact by heavily investing in academic, research, and innovation programs that benefit society, drive economies, promote sustainable growth, and contribute to comprehensive societal development.

chunks.title: About Us
chunks.text:
The faculty at LGU is highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated, consistently striving to create a student-centered learning environment through creative pedagogy. The institute features exceptional infrastructure facilities conducive to higher teaching-learning environments and research. We are committed to building strong collaborations with industry and academic institutions, both nationally and internationally, to enhance our research and innovation capacities. These efforts not only enrich the learning experience for our faculty and students but also provide opportunities for active participation in real-world projects, offering invaluable hands-on experience.
I warmly invite you to join us on this thrilling voyage of education, exploration, and creativity.
Maj Gen Muhammad Khalil Dar, HI(M) (Retd)

Dean’s Message
Our faculty is committed to fostering an environment where innovation, critical thinking, collaboration, and ethical responsibility thrive. We aim to empower our students to become responsible, skilled, and forward-thinking citizens who can contribute meaningfully to the future of technology and society. Along with academic excellence, we actively promote an entrepreneurial mindset by encouraging students to participate in national and international competitions, innovation-driven projects, and activities that develop creativity, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

chunks.title: Department of Computer Science
chunks.text:
Department of SE
The Faculty comprises three dynamic departments: Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence. Each department brings its own distinctive strengths: Computer Science provides a strong foundation in computing theories and problem-solving; Software Engineering focuses on the design, development, and management of reliable technological solutions; and Artificial Intelligence prepares students for emerging fields such as machine learning, intelligent systems, data-driven innovation, and automation. Together, these departments create a vibrant academic ecosystem that equips students to address modern challenges with creativity, competence, and integrity.
Through active student bodies, professional chapters, and academic societies, our students gain valuable opportunities for technical engagement, professional development, leadership, community service, networking, and exposure to emerging trends in computing and technology.

chunks.title: Department of Computer Science
chunks.text:
The steadily increasing merit of admission to our programmes is a strong reflection of the trust, reputation, and academic quality associated with our faculty. It bears witness to our commitment to continuous improvement, high standards, practical exposure, industry linkages, and student-centred opportunities. I encourage our students to engage actively with our programmes, make full use of the opportunities available to them, and contribute to a culture of respect, innovation, service, and excellence. Together, let us continue to build a community that advances technology while upholding the values of responsibility, inclusivity, and service to society.
Dr. Umer Iqbal
Acting Dean, Faculty of Computer Science

Dean’s Message
It is a great privilege to lead a diverse and dynamic academic community of social sciences. At LGU, we are committed to fostering a robust learning environment that equips our students with the skills and knowledge to excel in the ever-evolving global landscape.

chunks.title: Department of Social Science
chunks.text:
Department of Humanities and Arts
In today’s fast-paced world, the role of social sciences is more critical than ever. Management and social sciences not only shape our understanding of society, politics, and human behavior but also provide the tools to navigate complex challenges. The future of social sciences is intertwined with the integration of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and data analytics. These technologies are transforming industries, and we recognize their importance in preparing our students to thrive in a digitally-driven world. At LGU, we are embedding analytics and AI into our curriculum to ensure that our students are equipped with the analytical skills and technological fluency needed for the jobs of tomorrow.

chunks.title: Department of Social Science
chunks.text:
Department of Humanities and Arts
One of our core objectives is to provide students with international exposure. We are working to establish strong partnerships with leading academic institutions globally, offering students opportunities for exchange programs, internships, and cross-cultural collaborations. This international exposure not only broadens their academic horizons but also prepares them for the diverse challenges and opportunities in a globalized world.
Our faculty members, who are distinguished scholars and practitioners in their respective fields, play a pivotal role in shaping the educational experience at LGU. Their expertise, coupled with our state-of-the-art infrastructure, ensures that our students receive a world-class education. With modern classrooms, advanced laboratories, and cutting-edge digital resources, LGU stands as a beacon of academic excellence.

chunks.title: Department of Social Science
chunks.text:
We also emphasize employability and career readiness. Through our strategic collaborations with industry leaders, internships, and career development programs, we provide students with practical experience and the skills necessary to succeed in today’s competitive job market. Furthermore, our focus on transnational education ensures that our students are not only prepared for local opportunities but are also well-positioned to compete on the global stage.
LGU is committed to fostering an inclusive culture, ensuring access to higher education for all, including those from historically deprived segments of society, and providing them with the opportunities they need to succeed academically and professionally. We are driven by a shared commitment to innovation, excellence, and the holistic development of our students. As we look to the future, we are committed to grow as a responsible institution of higher education, offering a transformative learning experience that is globally relevant, technologically advanced, and deeply rooted in the values of social sciences.

chunks.title: Department of Social Science
chunks.text:
I look forward to collaborating with students, faculty, and stakeholders as we embark on this exciting journey of academic growth and global engagement.
Prof. Dr. Rizwana Bashir
Dean, Faculty of Social Sciences

chunks.title: Department of Basic Sciences
chunks.text:
Department of Physics
Welcome to the Faculty of Basic Sciences at Lahore Garrison University — a dynamic hub of academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and innovation. At LGU, our faculty is committed to nurturing future scientists and researchers through a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs. We proudly offer specialized degrees in Allied Health and Molecular Sciences (including Genetics, Biotechnology, and Human Nutrition & Dietetics), Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics — with focused pathways such as BS-Mathematics with Artificial Intelligence, MPhil Mathematics, and PhD Mathematics. Each program is thoughtfully designed to meet industry demands and align with global research developments. Our faculty members bring a wealth of international experience and expertise, ensuring a globally informed teaching and research environment. We are at the forefront of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the core of our curricula — empowering even BS-level students to engage in AI-based interdisciplinary research. Our department is rapidly positioning itself as a national leader in AI-enabled basic sciences education. Equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories, HEC-accredited programs, and flexible hybrid learning models, LGU provides a vibrant and immersive academic experience. Through our strategic MoU with the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute (PKLI), we offer students and researchers valuable opportunities for collaborative research and clinical application. Additionally, our HEC-recognized LGU Journal of Life Sciences serves as an international platform for scholarly contributions. Our graduates are making meaningful impacts in leading organizations both nationally and globally — a reflection of the strong academic foundation and professional grooming they receive at LGU. We remain dedicated to fostering a culture of inquiry, creativity, and inclusivity —shaping the next generation of leaders in science and innovation.

chunks.title: Department of Media & Communication Studies
chunks.text:
DEPARTMENT OF MEDIA & COMMUNICATION STUDIES
The Department of Media & Communication Studies has been striving for excellence in the realm of Communication Studies since 2005. The distinguishing kingpin of the department is its literal as well as figurative ‘instrumentality’ devised for practical learning in addition to the essential theoretical academic pursuits. The former is facilitated through state of the art well-structured practical platforms such as Broadcasting house, LGUTV, LGU Radio and LGU Newspaper where students tend to garner firsthand experience of contemporary media practices. Moreover, the Department of Media & Communication Studies also has the distinction of being the official media partner of HEC Educational Channel. Whereas, the theoretical learning is catalyzed through the highly qualified and experienced teaching faculty members who do not only ensure to bring their students at par with the preconceived dimensions of scholarly knowledge but also incite innovative approach among them to append to the existing body of research. It is due to this unique theory-and-practice mix that the graduates from this prestigious department are known for securing instant recruitments in various subfields of Media & Communication Studies including Public Relations, Advertising, Print Journalism, Radio & TV Production and Digital Media.

chunks.title: Department of Media & Communication Studies

The Department of Media & Communication Studies offers two academic programs ranging from undergraduate courses to M. Phil. Program. The department also encourages its students to participate in different societies and Media Club of Lahore Garrison University, where their collaborative efforts give vent to quasi-professional team building and team management skills for achieving different productive and progressive goals.
The Department of Media & Communication Studies welcomes all the interested and potential students to be a part of this invaluable experience so that they can ultimately be ushered into the global treads of Media Profession.
Vision:
To be a leading media education center, driving democratic discourse & inclusive socioeconomic progress.
Mission:
To foster a transformative media environment that equips faculty & students with integrated technologies, ethical storytelling skills and democratic mindset, enabling them to collaborate as responsible citizens on real world communication challenges and drive inclusive societal progress.

Department of POL SCI/IR/Pak Studies – Lahore Garrison University
DEPARTMENT OF INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND POLITICAL SCIENCE
Overview
Department takes pride in its prestigious M. Phil International Relations Program, which was kicked off in the Fall of the year 2016. It is assiduously pursued in two years, comprising four semesters and weighted thirty credit hours. This program is driven by the inland and qualified foreign doctorates and post-doctorate. The pedagogy is in Pakistan Studies, Political Sciences, International Relations and Current and International Affairs. This faculty is also delighted in conducting the Bachelor of Science in International Relations (BS IR). The objectives of this course are to highlight the significance and introduce the fundamentals of International Relations to the students.
Development Program of International Relations & Political Science Department, Lahore Garrison University, Lahore.

chunks.title: Department of POL SCI/IR/Pak Studies

Further, this Department is also catering for the needs of the teaching of Pakistan Studies, as a core subject, to the BS students of the whole University.
For further development and expansion/consolidation of the Department of International Relations & Political Science, the following planning scheme has been chalked out.
Start of the New Programs:
PhD in International Relations (IR) will start after the approval by HEC; the case is in progress.
Keeping in view the popularity of the new emerging disciplines of Peace and Conflict Studies (PCS) at the global level, the Department has planned to initiate the BS and MS programs in PCS. The Department is intended eventually to extend this program up to PhD level.

DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
Welcome! On behalf of the faculty, staff, and students of the Department of Computer Science at Lahore Garrison University, I extend a warm welcome to you. These are exciting times for computer science, as the field is now recognized as a vital source of tools and techniques driving advancements in nearly every aspect of human endeavor. Our students acquire competitive skills in the effective development and application of modern technology. We envision them as exceptional programmers, outstanding researchers, innovative designers, and extraordinary analysts. With rapid advancements in technology, we are committed to equipping you with the advanced competencies necessary to meet the growing demands of science and technology, particularly in computer science, across all professional domains. Our department prioritizes research, resulting in a significant volume of high-impact publications. The Department of Computer Science offers competitive degree programs in fast-evolving fields of study. Our qualified faculty and state-of-the-art facilities ensure you develop a strong technical foundation to apply your knowledge effectively in practical work environments. Recently, the National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC) of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan awarded our department an ‘X’ category. Whether you are a student, parent, alumnus, employer, or colleague, we value your feedback and suggestions, which will help us reach new heights and inspire us to maintain our commitment to excellence.

OVERVIEW

chunks.title: Department of Computer Science
chunks.text: The computer science department is one of the largest departments of the University offering a range of academic degree programs, including BSCS, MSCS, MSAI, and Ph.D. CS. The department employs a diverse group of faculty members with expertise in various computing disciplines. Research is a significant component of the computer science department. Faculty and students are often engaged in cutting-edge research areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer graphics, cybersecurity, computer vision, cloud computing, and various allied domains. The department has research labs and faculty members often secure research grants and collaborate with industry. The computer science department has different student societies and clubs such as TechSphere, GEARS, Google Developer Student Club, IEEE Student Branch, and ACM Student Chapter. These groups provide students with opportunities to network, learn, and participate in coding competitions, hackathons, and other extracurricular activities. The department has state-of-the-art facilities, including computer labs equipped with the latest hardware and software as well as specialized equipment for research purposes. Overall, the computer science department plays a vital role in educating the next generation of computer scientists, conducting research to advance the field, and contributing to the development of technology and its applications in various industries.

chunks.title: Department of Mathematics

Department of Mathematics – Lahore Garrison University
DEPARTMENT OF MATHEMATICS
Overview
Mathematics is the science that deals with the logic of shape, quantity, and arrangement. Math is all around us in everything we do. It is the building block for everything in our daily lives, including mobile devices, architecture (ancient and modern), art, money, engineering, and even sports.
Since the beginning of recorded history, mathematics discovery has been at the forefront of every civilized society and in use in even the most primitive of cultures. The need for math arose based on the wants of society: the more complex a society, the more complex the mathematical needs. Primitive tribes needed little more than the ability to count but also relied on math to calculate the position of the sun and the physics of hunting.

لاہور گیریژن یونیورسٹی، لاہور کا شعبۂ اُردو ان ابتدائی شعبہ جات میں شامل ہے، جنہوں نے یونیورسٹی کے قیام کے فوراً بعد ایم اے اور ایم فل کی تدریس کا آغاز کیا۔ ہائر ایجوکیشن کمیشن پنجاب کی منظوری کے بعد یونیورسٹی نے ترقی کی نئی منازل طے کرنا شروع کیں۔ 2012 میں شعبۂ اُردو نے ایم فل، اور 2016 میں پی ایچ ڈی اُردو کی تدریس کا آغاز ایک نئے عزم اور جذبے کے ساتھ کیا۔ 2024 کے اختتام تک شعبۂ اُردو سے 223 ایم فل اسکالرز اور 79 پی ایچ ڈی اسکالرز عبائے فضیلت زیب تن کر چکے ہیں۔
شعبۂ اُردو نے 2018 میں غیر ملکی طلبہ و طالبات کے لیے سرٹیفکیٹ اور ڈپلوما کورسز کا آغاز کیا، جو اب بھی کامیابی سے جاری ہیں۔ اسی سال دفتری اُردو زبان کا ایک کورس بھی شروع کیا گیا، جس کا مقصد قومی زبان کے فروغ کے ساتھ دفتری امور میں اُردو کو رائج کرنے کے لیے ماہر افرادی قوت تیار کرنا تھا۔

شعبۂ اُردو طلبہ کی ذہنی و علمی نشوونما کے لیے نصابی اور ہم نصابی سرگرمیوں کا انعقاد باقاعدگی سے کرتا رہتا ہے۔ اب تک شعبہ کے زیرِ اہتمام نو قومی و بین الاقوامی کانفرنسز، اُردو تحقیق پر پانچ ورکشاپس، مختلف توسیعی لیکچرز، اور اقبالیات کے فروغ سے متعلق تقریبات منعقد ہو چکی ہیں۔ بی ایس پروگرامز میں اقبالیات کو بطور لازمی مضمون شامل کیا گیا ہے۔

chunks.title: CS Programs
chunks.text: The Department of Computer Science is the largest department at Lahore Garrison University in terms of faculty and student strength. The department aims to generate a continuous stream of new scientific and technical knowledge; and to transform the young talented students into leaders of technology organizations. In order to fulfill its mission, the department strives to create a culture that attracts, develops, and retains the best available scientific and technical minds. The Department of Computer Science encourages its faculty members and students to undertake research & development and engage in collaborative work with industry. This provides them insight into the real-world problems and they strive to find out pragmatic solutions for industry. The Computer Science departments’ objective is to discover, preserve and disseminate knowledge and produce technology leaders through creative work. In addition, we aim to produce quality human resource that plays an important role in technological advancement and sustainable growth of the society. Our faculty, students, alumni, and staff endeavor to achieve these objectives with responsibility and fidelity.

chunks.title: Regulations
chunks.text:
Regulations – Lahore Garrison University
Regulations
Regulations
The management, Staff and the Students of Executive Committee work in complete harmony to uphold the Islamic values, maintain excellent discipline and achieve high academic goals. The students are expected to abide by the following:
ATTENDANCE:
Aspecific percentage of attendance i.e. 80% is compulsory for send up Examination, as well as Final Exam.
SECURITY FUND
It is refundable and the demand for the refund of security fee must be made within 3 months after leaving the university. When the students leave the university clearance from all departments including the library is a pre-requisite.
BREAKAGE FEE
Students are required to pay “Breakage fee” in case of any breakage/damage done by them in the Laboratories during the practical or inside the campus. This fee is not deducted from the security, instead, it is payable immediately to compensate for the loss.
EXAMINATION RULE

chunks.title: Regulations
chunks.text:
A student will be given a maximum of Two chances to clear the send up examinations. If a student fails to clear all the subjects in these Two attempts, then his/her admission will not be sent as a regular student.
SECURITY
(A) Students must acquire their University Identity cards soon after their admission. Students must display the identity cards at all times in the campus and present it on demand of any faculty member. Failure to produce ID card on demand by any faculty member shall warrant a fine of Rs. 50. In case of loss a new card will be issued on payment of Rs. 300. The card must be returned to university admin office on discharge from the university.
(B) Record of names and addresses of owners/drivers of vehicles and registration number of vehicles is kept with the university authorities for the security and safety of students.

chunks.title: Regulations
chunks.text:
(C) Students having valid driving license can park their cars/motorcycles in the parking area, only after obtaining a permit from the office. All students are expected to show the highest standard of conduct and discipline both inside and outside the Campus premises. The Administration attaches great importance to this aspect and strives to maintain an orderly ambiance of the campus at all costs. Failure on the part of the students to come up to the desired standard of conduct and discipline may result in their suspension / expulsion. Following are the areas which if violated would come under misconduct and merit very strict punitive action resulting in immediate rustication / expulsion. Without valid driving license car/Motor cycle is not allowed to be parked in the university parking area.
NOT ALLOWED
Possession of weapons
Sharp edged items
Knuckles
Any equipment / instrument with which someone else could be harmed
Narcotics and Cigarettes
Pornographic material
Being insolent / rude towards a member of the faculty / staff.
Willfully and deliberately damaging university property.

chunks.title: Physics Programs
chunks.text:
Physics, being the key field of sciences, deals with the core concepts of physics as well as their application in different fields. It is a diversified field that gives birth to many other disciplines over the decades, such as Electronics, Material Sciences, and Engineering, etc. After completing the degree, the Postgraduates may avail the opportunity to work with the following:
Able to give a physical interpretation to a mathematical equation and conversely apply mathematics to physical phenomena
Demonstrate the ability to present clear, logical, and concise arguments, including prose and mathematical language
Can represent key aspects of physics through graphs and diagrams, and use geometric arguments in problem-solving
Demonstrate the ability to justify and explain their thinking and/or approach, both written and oral, and an ability to communicate effectively
Make measurements on physical systems understanding the limitations of the measurements and the limitations of models used to interpret the measurements

chunks.title: Physics Programs
chunks.text:
Computationally model the behavior of physical systems, and understand the limitations of the algorithm and the machine
An ability to design and conduct experiments, as well as to analyze and interpret experimental data
Complete an experimental, computational or theoretical research project under the guidance of faculty and report on this project in writing and orally to an audience of peers and faculty
An ability to identify, formulate, and solve physics problems and the ability to apply knowledge of physics in other interdisciplinary fields
An understanding of professional and ethical responsibility
The broad education necessary to understand the impact of solutions of physical problems in a global, economic, environmental, and societal context, including knowledge of contemporary issues

chunks.text:
Department of Psychology Home – Lahore Garrison University
Department of Psychology Home
Overview
Psychology-the study of mind and behavior, is one of today’s most exciting and rapidly advancing scientific frontiers. The department of Psychology is dedicated to provide students with high-quality and rigorous education in the classroom and beyond. The mission of the Department of Psychology is to prepare students for the study and service of Psychology. We seek to empower students to lead and effect positive change in the world by instructing them the ethical, systematic study of behavior and mental processes, and the application of Psychology to community and global issues with the expectation of intellectual engagement and academic excellence.
We have vibrant BS, M.Sc. and M.Phil Applied Psychology, ADCP and MS Clinical Psychology Programs. These programs offer training in different areas of Psychology including Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Health Psychology, Experimental Psychology, Research Methods and Social Psychology.

chunks.title: Department of Psychology Home
chunks.text:
Department of Psychology Home
The central objective of these programs is to provide training and experience necessary for students to become not only skilled psychologists and dedicated researchers, but also effective communicators of the knowledge and findings on which the science of Psychology rests.
Vision:
The vision of the Department of Psychology at Lahore Garrison University is to be a top leading department in education, research and innovation in the field of Psychology in Pakistan.
Mission:
The mission of the Department of Psychology is to educate, counsel and inspire our students with passion, knowledge, research and wisdom for the application of Psychology in professional and friendly environment so that they become independent and self motivated learners, healthy citizens and inspiring leaders to bring an effective positive social change at national horizons.

To improve Clinical Training / placements of MSCP and MPhil programs.
To initiate BS Clinical Psychology program.
To initiate PhD degree programs in Clinical Psychology & MPhil Applied Psychology in 2020-21 and for that, hiring more PhD faculty with international exposure.

To grow the budding “Garrison Counseling & Clinical Centre” at University students, staff and community levels.
To acquire and provide training in teaching, research and soft skills to all faculty members and extend such services for outside institutions.

chunks.text:
BS WCCI (Hons) 4 Years – Lahore Garrison University
BS in White Collar Crime Investigation
Programme Overview
Fighting Corruption is among the most important priorities among any developing nation. This degree programme focuses on providing hands on experience to the graduates to focus on investigation and mitigating the risk of fraud in public and private organizations. After the completion of this degree programme, the graduates will be able to investigate white collar crimes.
Programme Objectives
To prepare Fraud Investigators keep in view the requirements of the existing stakeholders, agencies, and industry who can contribute towards decreasing corruption by using technology to conduct rapid and effective fraud investigation.
To educate students keeping in view the requirements of the existing stakeholder, agencies, and industry to investigate white-collar crimes and decrease corruption.
To create awareness about the emerging technologies used in investigating white collar crimes.
To develop strong ethical values among the students so they can use them in the workplace.

chunks.title: BS WCCI (Hons) 4 Years
chunks.text:
Develop understanding among students concerning core areas of white collar crimes, corruption and anti-corruption, anti-money laundering and counter financing of terrorism.
To develop strong communication skills with due emphasis on technical report writing skills which are required for corporate sector investigation and public sector investigation.
Program Learning Outcomes
Students shall be able to utilize the core concept of white-collar crime investigation, digital forensics, anti-money laundering and counter financing for terrorism in the field.
Apply fundamental concepts of investigation such as pre- investigation requirement fulfilment, following investigation protocols, and delivering the outcomes of the findings to the stakeholders.
Apply the fundamental white collar crimes, corruption and anti-corruption, anti-money laundering and counter financing of terrorism..

chunks.title: BS WCCI (Hons) 4 Years
chunks.text:
Program Learning Outcomes
Identification of the vulnerabilities and loopholes within the organizational policies, and procedures related to traditional as well as the computational system, conducting gap analysis, and developing fraud mitigation strategies.
Students will have in-depth knowledge about the use of tools and techniques which are used for solving crimes.
Students will use the modern tools available in the market for analysing digital evidence and articulating results based on the analysis drawn using the tools.
Must be able to utilize the tools to conduct digital forensic analysis.
Must be able to understand the hardware and software architecture of computer systems and be able to explain the function and interaction of computer processing units, memories, and input/output devices.
Students will be eligible to define and explain the important elements involved in post incident investigations and recovery plans.
The students will have the related knowledge of the laws applicable to digital evidence and related investigations.

BS CS Overview – Lahore Garrison University
BSCS – Program Educational Objectives or Program Objectives (PEOs or PO):
The graduates of Computer Science program will have following capabilities/ skills / attributes four years after their graduation.
1. Comprehend the technology-oriented courses, facilitate research, promote new business ideas, and enhance computing solutions development practices.
2. Inculcate presentation and communication skills and create awareness about moral and social values.
3. Apply concepts of various subjects in integration with computing & emerging technologies.
4. Exhibit critical thinking, and problem-solving skills for advancing in higher studies.

PLOs | Description
PLO-1 Academic Education | To prepare graduates as computing professionals.

chunks.title: BS CS Overview
chunks.text:
Program Learning Outcomes/Graduate Attributes (PLOs/GAs)
PLO-2 Knowledge for Solving Computing Problems | Apply knowledge of computing fundamentals, knowledge of a computing specialization, and mathematics, science, and domain knowledge appropriate for the computing specialization to the abstraction and conceptualization of computing models from defined problems and requirements.
PLO-3 Problem Analysis | Identify, formulate, research literature, and solve complex computing problems reaching substantiated conclusions using fundamental principles of mathematics, computing sciences, and relevant domain disciplines.
PLO-4 Design / Development of Solutions | Design and evaluate solutions for complex computing problems, and design and evaluate systems, components, or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
PLO-5 Modern Tool Usage | Create, select, adapt, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern computing tools to complex computing activities, with an understanding of the limitations.

chunks.title: BS CS Overview
chunks.text:

PLO-7 Communication | Communicate effectively with the computing community and with society at large about complex computing activities by being able to comprehend and write effective reports, design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and understand clear instructions.
PLO-8 Computing Professionalism and Society | Understand and assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues within local and global contexts, and the consequential responsibilities relevant to professional computing practice.
PLO-9 Ethics | Understand and commit to professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of professional computing practice.
PLO-10 Lifelong Learning | Recognize the need, and have the ability, to engage in independent learning for continual development as a computing professional.

chunks.title: MSCS Overview
chunks.text:
MSCS Overview – Lahore Garrison University
Programme overview and scope:

chunks.title: MSCS Overview
chunks.text:
The Master of Science in Computer Science (MSCS) degree Programme is designed to integrate advanced coursework with independent research, equipping students for impactful careers in technology, academia, or doctoral pursuits. The curriculum features core courses that deepen expertise in foundational areas such as Computer Architecture, Operating Systems, Theory of Automata, Analysis of Algorithms, and Theory of Programming Languages, alongside a diverse selection of electives that enable students to align their studies with personal interests and industry trends. Emphasizing technological innovation, the Programme incorporates experiential learning through hands-on projects, state-of-the-art research, and collaboration on emerging technologies. Students culminate their studies with a thesis, offering a platform to specialize in a specific domain and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer vision, biomedical imaging, cybersecurity, cloud computing, image processing, and data science.
Programme Objectives:

chunks.title: MSCS Overview
chunks.text:
The main objectives of the MSCS degree Programme are:
• To strengthen the understanding and competence of students in computer science fundamentals.
• To introduce specialized courses with theoretical and practical knowledge, belong to salient areas of computing to broaden the vision of students.
• To develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills among students to address non-trivial problems.
• To promote research capabilities and enable students to make an active contribution in challenging research areas.
• To prepare students for higher studies.
Learning Outcomes:
After the successful completion of MSCS degree the students will be able:
• To effectively communicate, comprehend and apply computing knowledge to develop efficient solutions for real life problems.
• To critically evaluate the existing solution-based systems in the computing industry for their improvement.
• To critically analyze existing computing studies and identify the research gaps.
• To perform research and come up with innovative solutions in their relevant fields.

chunks.title: MSCS Overview
chunks.text:
• To work effectively in the team including multidisciplinary members to solve computing problems.
• To understand the professional/research ethics and responsibilities of a computer scientist.
.

chunks.title: Overview of the Program (Mass Communication)
chunks.text:
Overview of the Program (Mass Communication) – Lahore Garrison University
Overview of the Program
Digital English Journalism is designed to address the emergent need to train general audience regarding news production on digital media. Owing to the recent boom in social media platforms and converging the need to learn its effective use, this course is aimed at providing the students with the basics and technical use of new media. Students will gain this knowledge by engaging in understanding, creating, processing, and manipulating the digital content through modern technologies to bring about effective communication through a combination of theoretical and practical challenges. Through this program, the students will be instilled with basics of the English Content Writing followed by a thorough insight into the advanced field of Digital Media. Due to the multidimensional nature of this program, the certified students of this degree can enhance their skills in several career lines such as independent Digital Media Entrepreneurship, Digital Content creator and blogging.

chunks.title: Overview of the Program (Mass Communication)
chunks.text:
Objectives to offer Program
The prime objectives to initiate Digital English Journalism are:
To teach people the importance of better communication skills on Digital Media especially social media
To clear the understanding of Digital Media platforms and to explain how citizens can be a part of Journalism through it
To enhance the youth’s ability of representing Pakistan with ethical consideration and to be able to critically analyze media content
To make the students digitally independent for creating their own content for different media sites using the simplest available device, their mobile phones
Learning Outcomes

chunks.title: Overview of the Program (Mass Communication)
chunks.text: After completing this course student will become a properly trained social media activist with a specialization in English content creation on various media platforms. This course will enable students to generate multiple stories using your own mobile phone device. It will make students adaptable to the changes and variations of different social platforms. This course will increase the inability of the students to enhance their theoretical and professional skills for practical fields to their utmost. It will polish their skills to the highest standards for securing market positions as Bloggers, Vloggers, Digital Content Producers, Podcasters, in future.

chunks.title: Bachelor of Science in Physics Road Map
chunks.text:
Bachelor of Science in Physics Road Map – Lahore Garrison University
Bachelor of Science in Physics
OVERVIEW
Physics is the natural science of matter involving the study of matter, its fundamental constituents its motion and behavior through space and time, and the related entities of energy and force. Physics is one of the most fundamental scientific disciplines, with its main goal being to understand how the universe behaves. A scientist who specializes in the field of physics is called a physicist.
Objectives and Program Outcomes
Program Mission:
To produce competent physicists with excellent knowledge who are capable to apply practical skills in different areas of physics for employment and higher education through providing curriculum based on liberal arts education to ensure greater breadth of knowledge along with in-depth knowledge of physics by offering an opportunity to learn and experience various aspects of physics under one roof.
Program Objective:
The BS Physics program objectives are to:

chunks.title: Bachelor of Science in Physics Road Map
chunks.text:
To ensure that the undergraduate education focuses not only on the main field of specialization but also provides exposure to the interdisciplinary areas of knowledge.
To promote application of academic knowledge to effectively respond to real life, entrepreneurial and industry challenges and requirements.
To equip students with the sense and ability to demonstrate creativity, curiosity, exploration and reflective problem solving.
Program Outcomes:
Organize and carry out solutions to long, complex physics problems.
Function effectively both as a leader and as a member of project teams.
Decide on strategies to be used and assumptions that need to be made.
Determine what constitutes sufficient evidence for a conclusion.
Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in multidisciplinary teams
Eligibility Criteria
12 years education i.e. FSc Pre Medical or FSc Pre Engineering or ICS (Physics & Mathematics) or Equivalent Certificate.
14 years education, BSc (2 years) or ADP or Equivalent Certificate for admission in 5th semester.
Minimum 45% marks.

chunks.title: MS Data Science Overview
chunks.text:
MS Data Science Overview – Lahore Garrison University
Programme overview and scope:
MS degree programme in Data science will provide students the comprehensive skills and knowledge they need to pursue the best career option in one of the most dynamic areas of modern technology. The program will prepare students with broad scientific knowledge, an aptitude in a variety of mathematical and statistical techniques and the ability to synthesize. The main aim of the program is to provide students with the options to be part of a data science endeavour that begins with the identification of business processes, determination of data provenance and ownership, understanding the ecosystem of the business decisions, skill sets and tools that shape the data, making data amenable to analytics, identifying sub-problems, recognizing the technology matrix required for problem resolution, creating incrementally-complex data-driven models and then maintaining them to ultimately leverage them for business growth.
Programme Objectives:
The main objectives of the MSDS degree programme are:

chunks.title: MS Data Science Overview
chunks.text:
⦁ To equip students with an in-depth understanding of core and advanced concepts in data science, including data engineering, machine learning, statistical modeling, and big data technologies.
⦁ To develop students’ ability to think critically and analytically, enabling them to design and implement data-driven solutions that address complex organizational and societal challenges.
⦁ To train students in the application of advanced computational, statistical, and machine learning methodologies to extract meaningful insights from diverse and large-scale datasets.
⦁ To produce professionals capable of meeting the growing demand for data science expertise in national and international markets, across industries such as finance, healthcare, and technology.
⦁ To encourage students to engage in innovative research and prepare for advanced studies, enabling contributions to cutting-edge developments in data science and related fields.
Learning Outcomes:
After the completion of degree students will be able:

chunks.title: MS Data Science Overview
chunks.text:
⦁ Comprehensive Knowledge: To demonstrate a deep understanding of specialized areas in data science, including machine learning, big data analytics, and statistical modeling, fostering a broad perspective on the field’s potential applications and impact.
⦁ Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: To exhibit strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex, data-driven challenges, applying innovative and evidence-based approaches to real-world scenarios.
⦁ Practical Application: To apply advanced data science tools, techniques, and methodologies to develop solutions that address critical societal and industrial needs, delivering strategic value.
⦁ Research Excellence: To conduct impactful research in challenging areas of data science, contributing novel insights, methodologies, and advancements to the field’s body of knowledge.
⦁ Academic Readiness: To demonstrate readiness for advanced studies, including doctoral programs, in data science and allied disciplines, at globally renowned institutions.

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Overview
chunks.text:
Ph.D CS Overview – Lahore Garrison University
The aim of PhD programme is to provide a vibrant and dynamic environment that encourages excellence in different research areas. The students are provided with an opportunity to conduct in-depth studies and focus on research in selected areas of computer science. The programme is intended to foster high quality and advanced research, so as to meet the society’s demand for high caliber professionals who are knowledgeable and well versed with the latest technologies and can provide a leading role in the academia as well as in the industry. A due emphasis has been placed on the applied and industrial aspects of the research. The programme consists of detailed courses that prepare students for advanced research that would help solve problems in a variety of disciplines. Through this rigorous process, scholars are trained to independently formulate and develop creative solutions to novel as well as existing problems. After completing their degrees, graduates can work in academia, industry, biomedicine, and business.
Programme Objectives

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Overview
chunks.text:
Ph.D CS Overview – Lahore Garrison University
The main objectives of PhD computer science degree programme are:
To enhance systematic understanding of the computing domain and mastery of the skills and methods associated with this domain.
To promote the capacity for critical analysis, assessment, and synthesis of innovative and complex ideas related to computer science.
To build a capacity for devising, designing, and performing research that has a real academic and industrial impact.
To develop an ability to excel in a productive academic and research career, including teaching, publications, grant writing, and conference presentations.
To groom scholars for valuable progress in technological, social, or cultural terms within a professional context.
Learning Outcomes
After the completion of degree scholars will be able to:
Identify problems faced in the country primarily and globally at large
Develop and design solutions to solve the complex real-world problems using various domains of knowledge
Create autonomous systems/ agents for solving complex real-world problems.

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Overview
chunks.text:
Develop the tools and techniques to make strategically important impact on industry and society
Pursue post-doctoral studies within the computing domain at top ranked institutes of the world.
Take a leadership role both in academia and computing industry.

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Admission Criteria
chunks.text:
Ph.D CS Admission Criteria – Lahore Garrison University
Admission Eligibility and Selection Criteria
i. Basic Academic Qualification:
⦁ For admission in PhD programs, a minimum CGPA of 3.0 (out of 4.0 in the semester system) or 60% (in the annual system) in the MS/MPhil/equivalent degree being considered for admission, is required, whether such degree was obtained from Pakistani or foreign universities.
⦁ If the CGPA/Percentage is not mentioned on the transcript, the candidate must produce equivalent weightage from the parent university.
⦁ The students having strong demonstrated interest in obtaining PhD degree, but their CGPA is below 3.00 (out of 4.0 in the semester system) or 60% marks (in the annual system) in the most recent degree obtained, may be admitted to a PhD program after fulfilling the following requirements:
Shall study additional courses of 9-12 CH of level 7 taking a zero semester at admission awarding university/HEI/DAI and score minimum 3.00 out of 4.00 GPA, and

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Admission Criteria
chunks.text:
The admission committee is satisfied that the applicant’s knowledge of primary area (level 7) has sufficiently prepared him or her to undertake the course of studies of the doctoral program.
These requirements shall be in addition to any other requirements set in this policy for admission to a PhD program.
ii. Admission Test and Interview: The GRE/GAT/HAT-General conducted by testing bodies accredited by HEC or University Admission Test, with a minimum cumulative score of 60%, is required for admission to the PhD CS Programme. The GAT test score is valid for a period of two years. Additionally, candidates must achieve at least 50% marks in the interview.
iii. Interdisciplinary Qualification: Consistent with best practices internationally (including leading global universities), intradisciplinary admissions is allowed, if:
The applicant has a strong interest in pursuing a PhD in a different discipline.
The applicant has passed GRE-Subject/Equivalent Test with minimum 50% marks in the discipline of admission and has taken 6-9 CH of deficiency courses of level 7.

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Admission Criteria
chunks.text:
The admission committee is satisfied that the applicant’s knowledge of the primary area (level 7) has sufficiently prepared him or her to undertake the course of study of the doctoral program (or, in the opinion of the admissions committee, the preparation can be deemed satisfactory by taking a few additional courses after starting the program).
iv. Statement of Purpose: As part of the application for admission to PhD programs, applicants shall be required to submit a statement of purpose, which shall form an integral part of the application. The admissions committee shall use the information provided to ascertain the preparedness and interest of the candidate in pursuing doctoral studies, and whether the department has the requisite resources to train and supervise the doctoral candidate in the subspeciality in which the applicant is interested. A statement of purpose shall, at least, include the following:
Title of the potential research proposal
Clear articulation of the current understanding of the intended field and ideas for potential research

chunks.title: Ph.D CS Admission Criteria
chunks.text:
Explanation of the intended impact of the proposed research
The prospective candidates shall demonstrate passion and enthusiasm for the area of research.

chunks.title: PhD Chemistry Programme Overview and Scope
chunks.text:
PhD Chemistry Programme Overview and Scope – Lahore Garrison University
Programme Overview and Scope:
PhD Program of Chemistry Department, LGU, offers a rigorous and comprehensive research-based education that prepares scholars for successful careers in academia, industry, government, and other scientific fields. With a strong emphasis on cutting-edge research, our program equips graduates with the knowledge, skills, and expertise necessary to address complex challenges in the field of chemistry.
1. Social
Students holding PhD degrees in Chemistry study have in-depth knowledge on different scientific equipment, their usages, analytical study of different chemical compounds and more. This understanding will help them to discover new compounds, medicines etc. and improve the human life quality.
2. Market

chunks.title: PhD Chemistry Programme Overview and Scope
chunks.text:
According to the present scenario, it has been proven that the demand of Chemistry study in the research field is increasing gradually. Through obtaining a PhD in Chemistry, the graduates can hold senior positions in the research field and academic sectors. Chemistry has a wide variety of applications so it creates constant demand for well-trained chemists in many fields. Chemists have great scope in industries, health departments, mineralogy department, ministry of environment, pharmacy, agriculture and teaching jobs such as research chemist, research associate, analytical chemistry associate, chemistry project assistant, organic chemistry professor, synthetic organic chemist etc.
3. Employment

chunks.title: PhD Chemistry Programme Overview and Scope
chunks.text:
After completing this program successfully, the chemistry graduates are hired in the chemical and related industries, such as pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, petrochemicals, toiletries, plastics and polymers. However, those who studied chemistry may enter many different sectors including the food and drink industry, utilities and research, health and medical organizations and agencies. PhD chemistry graduates may adopt following careers:
Teaching and Research in Public and private Universities
Chemical Industries (Fertilizers, Cement, Paint and Dyes, polymer, Glass Industry etc.)
Atomic Energy
Food scientist
Pharmaceutical Industry
Chemical Research and Development
Pharmacy, Pharmacology and Medicinal Chemistry
Forensic Scientist, Patent Lawyer
Environmental Analyst, Environment Protection Agencies
Technical Advisor
Quality Control
Technical Sales and Service
Technical and Science Writing
Government Organizations (Agriculture Department, Irrigation Department etc.)

chunks.title: PhD Chemistry Programme Objectives
chunks.text:
PhD Chemistry Programme Objectives – Lahore Garrison University
Programme Objectives:
To prepare the students for having thorough understanding of the principles, methods and concepts of modern chemistry.
To enable the students to efficiently design and carry out their research independently which could potentially lead to the new avenues of practically applicable knowledge, systematic investigations leading to scientific discoveries.
To improve the interpersonal communication skills of the students as well as their presentation skills within and across the disciplinary lines.
To prepare the students for different career opportunities in academia and industry with an advanced doctorate degree in chemistry.

chunks.title: PhD Chemistry Learning Outcomes
chunks.text:
PhD Chemistry Learning Outcomes – Lahore Garrison University
Learning Outcomes
Consolidate the diversity of viewpoints, approaches and balance between basic and applied research in Chemistry, offering a rich intellectual atmosphere.
Achieve a molecular level understanding of the natural world and thus forms the basis for much of modern Chemistry.
Cultivate the students’ conscientious working attitude, and train students to face challenges and make innovations.
Inculcate the understanding of ethical conduct of research.
Develop the skill to perform a critical analysis of scientific research problems in the field of chemistry.
Promotion of professional development and growth of the faculty.

chunks.title: Criminology Overview
chunks.text:
Criminology Overview – Lahore Garrison University
Introduction
The BS (4-Year) Programme in Criminology has been designed to disseminate a blend of theoretical and practical knowledge needed to understand crime, criminal behavior and criminality. It is an interdisciplinary programme comprising 127 credit hours to be completed in eight semesters. Apart from general and elective courses, the programme consists of nine foundation courses, twelve major courses including internship and thesis/ research project.
This programme is developed to provide the young graduates with job-oriented skills to augment employability and producing young professionals to re-shape the policies to prevent crime in Pakistan in general.

chunks.title: Criminology Overview
chunks.text:
The major objective of this programme is to provide the students with hands- on-training in the specialized fields of criminology such as forensic criminology, criminal and juvenile justice systems, criminal investigation, geographic crime analysis, crime mapping and security related issues through its extensive internship programme. Special focus has been given on developing research skills. Students are required to carry out research projects/thesis to uncover the major issues related to the field of criminology.
Mission statement

chunks.title: Criminology Overview
chunks.text: Transformation of social, political and economic structures in the wake of globalization has resulted in various challenges including increasing incidence of crime and violence. Scientific understanding is needed to deal with such issues. Realizing the need of emerging discipline of criminology, Higher Education Commission (HEC) has taken the initiative to launch BS (4- Years) Programme in Criminology. This programme will help to develop the understanding of young graduates about theoretical and practical knowledge of crime and deviance in Pakistan. The programme will develop analytical skills of the students to tone down criminality in Pakistan.

Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry – Lahore Garrison University
Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry
Program Vision
Produce creative and innovative postgraduates in the field of Chemistry who become instrumental in upholding its international standards.
Program Mission
To contribute in technical and socio-economic development through research based quality education, targeting excellence in basic and applied research while fully engaging them on professional skills.
Program Objectives
To impart postgraduate students with a conceptual understanding of the basic and Advanced level Chemistry.
To develop the capability of analyzing, addressing and posing solutions to problems related to applied research.
To enhance student competence in the design and conduct of experiments and analysis and presentation of experimental data and results.
To equip students with the necessary skills set for pursuing careers in Chemistry education, research and industry.
Program Learning Outcomes
After the completion of M.Phil. Chemistry degree, students will be able to:

chunks.title: Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry
chunks.text:
Appreciate the theoretical and experimental skills making them capable of designing, predicting, modeling and analyzing the behavior of Chemical processes.
Spirit of working individually as well as in interactive groups with the necessary requirements of scientific and professional ethics.
Grasp hands on experience and scientific communication skills to clearly present their research work.
Play role at national level in the increase of higher education standards and can positively fulfill the needs in the industry

Admission is purely merit-based and rests solely on the following criteria:
Submission of Complete Application

Supporting documents by the stipulated deadline

chunks.title: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry

To improve the interpersonal communication skills of the students as well as their presentation skills within and across the disciplinary lines.

Consolidate the diversity of viewpoints, approaches and balance between basic and applied research in Chemistry, offering a rich intellectual atmosphere.

Promotion of professional development and growth of the faculty.

chunks.title: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry
chunks.text:
Admission/Eligibility Criteria
Eighteen years of education (MS/M.Phil. Chemistry) or Equivalent degree with minimum CGPA of 3.0/4.0 (Semester system) or 1 st Division (60% marks: annual system), and in accordance with instructions issued from time to time by HEC and no third division (annual system) or ‘D’ grade (semester system) throughout the academic career.
GRE GAT (Subject) minimum 60% marks or departmental test conducted by the university admission committee at par with GRE in accordance to instructions issued by HEC.
Interview conducted by the university admission committee.
Programme Structure

To be eligible for the award of PhD Degree, a student must have met the following requirements in the subsequent order in due course:
1. | Successful completion of coursework with minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA
2. | Comprehensive exam with 50% passing marks
3. | Approval of synopsis after qualifying comprehensive exam.
4. | Successful completion of research work
5. | Publish at least one paper in HEC recognized journal
6. | Approval of PhD thesis by foreign reviewing committee
7. | Final Defense

chunks.title: Road Map of BS Electronics
chunks.text:
Road Map of BS Electronics – Lahore Garrison University
Bachelor of Science in Electronics
OVERVIEW
Electronics is an important discipline that finds its use in a large number of applications. Continual advances in electronics in the areas of materials, processes, devices and circuits have been leading to rapid advances in the existing applications of electronics as well as in the emergence of new applications. To harness the full potential of developments in electronics and further advance the technologies related to electronics, it is important to have strong BS Electronics program to educate and train individuals in this key discipline of science. Keeping in mind the overall objectives to be achieved through this program of study, the curriculum of BS Electronics has been developed.
Objectives and Program Outcomes
Program Mission:

chunks.title: Road Map of BS Electronics
chunks.text:
To educate our students to meet high standards of excellence in Electronics and in preparation for professional careers and advanced studies. To create and disseminate new knowledge through basic and applied research in the Electronics. To provide policy and development leadership for the growth of innovation led Electronics in an Industry.
Program Objective:
The BS Electronics program objectives are to:
To ensure that the undergraduate education focuses not only on the main field of specialization but also provides exposure to the interdisciplinary areas of knowledge.
To promote application of academic knowledge to effectively respond to real life, entrepreneurial and industry challenges and requirements.
To equip students with the sense and ability to demonstrate creativity, curiosity, exploration and reflective problem solving.
Program Outcomes:
Knowledge: Ability to apply knowledge of mathematics and sciences in the field of electronics.
Analysis: Ability to identify scientific problems, as well as to analyze and interpret data.

chunks.title: Road Map of BS Electronics
chunks.text:
Design and Problem Solving: Ability to formulate or design electronic systems as well as to solve problems related to the discipline.
Technical Skills: Ability to use the techniques, skills, and modern scientific tools necessary for professional practice.
Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in multidisciplinary teams
Eligibility Criteria
12 years education i.e. FSc Pre Engineering or ICS (Physics & Mathematics) or Equivalent Certificate.
14 years education, BSc (2 years) or ADP or Equivalent Certificate for admission in 5th semester.
Minimum 45% marks.
Gap Period-3 years (Relaxation can be given if needed).

chunks.title: Post Associate Degree Programs
chunks.text:
Post Associate Degree Programs – Lahore Garrison University
Post Associate Degree Programs
The Department of Management Sciences offers Post ADP in the field of BBA and BSAF.
Pathway for Associate Degrees Holders:
Students having completed Associate Degrees shall be allowed admission in the fifth semester of the undergraduate/equivalent degree program offered in the same discipline without any deficiency course.
Where the disciplines of the Associate Degree and the undergraduate/equivalent degree program are different, students shall be required to complete deficiency courses through a bridging semester before the fifth semester as determined by the admitting university.
The minimum eligibility for admission in the fifth semester in above cases is 2.00/4.00 CGPA in the prior qualification i.e., Associate Degree. The admitting university may, however, set higher eligibility criteria for admission in the fifth semester of the four-year undergraduate/equivalent degree program.
Pathway for Conventional Two-Year BA/BSc/Equivalent Degree Holders:

chunks.title: Post Associate Degree Programs
chunks.text:
Students having completed conventional two-year BA/BSc/equivalent degree programs shall be allowed admission in the fifth semester of the undergraduate/equivalent degree program, in which case students shall be required to complete deficiency courses through a bridging semester before commencement of the fifth semester as determined by the admitting university.
The minimum eligibility for admission in the fifth semester in this case is 45% cumulative score in the prior qualification i.e., conventional two-year BA/BSc/equivalent degree programs. The admitting university may however set higher eligibility criteria for admission in the fifth semester of the undergraduate/equivalent degree program.
Further details on UGEP can be accessed from HEC policy document.
https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/policies/Pages/UGEP.aspx

BS Economics with Data Analytics
BS Economics with Data Analytics
The BS Economics with Data Analytics is a cutting-edge, interdisciplinary program that blends rigorous economic theory with advanced data analytics, preparing students to solve real-world problems through evidence-based decision-making. By integrating hands-on learning in data analytical tools, the program empowers graduates to analyse complex economic data, uncover insights, and drive strategic outcomes across sectors like finance, public policy, development, and technology. In an era where data shapes every major decision, this program cultivates a new generation of economists equipped to lead with intelligence, innovation, and impact.
A. Why BS Economics with Data Analytics?
a) Where Critical Thinking Meets Computation
b) Make Smarter Decisions with Data-Driven Insights
c) Launch your career as an Economic Analyst / Data Scientist
d) Explore diverse career paths: (Finance, Banking, Tech, Policy Research Centers)

MPhil English Literature
MPhil English Literature
Course Duration: 2 Years
Total Credit Hours: 30
Semester: 4
Apply Now
Fee Structure
Programme Objectives
The MPhil English program intends to:
Enhance literary competence among students by a comparative analysis of different writers/ critiques, genres and themes in English Literature.
Analyze the complex interactions and interdependencies of global, regional and local aspects of life in the social, economic, political and religious spheres.
Empower students’ critical thinking in the interpretation of texts through research-oriented learning.
Programme Learning Outcomes
The successful students of MPhil English Literature will be able to:
Construe the complex interactions and interdependencies of global, regional and local aspects of life in the social, economic, political and religious spheres.
Analyze various literary texts and theories of global and multicultural literatures through comparative analysis.

chunks.title: MPhil English Literature
chunks.text:
Design research projects/thesis by employing their critical analytical skills in order to meet modern world needs.
Course Duration
Minimum duration of MPhil English Literature program (24+6=30) is 02 years and maximum three years. Course work of 24 credit hours is required to be completed in the first year ( two semesters) followed by a comprehensive examination and thesis of 6 credit hours in the next year( two semesters).
Admission Requirements
A candidate seeking admission in MPhil English Literature program should have completed sixteen years of education or 4 years of education after FA/FSc/A level or equivalent in English.
A candidate must have 50% marks (under annual system; MA English) or 2.5 out of 4.00 CGPA (under semester system) in BS English program.
A university GAT test will be conducted by department admission committee. Qualifying score for this test will be 50%. There is no age limit for admission to MPhil program.
Note: Merit list of minimum 10 students of MPhil programme will be displayed.
Degree Requirements

chunks.title: MPhil English Literature
chunks.text:
Enrolled Students must complete 24 credit hours in 2 semesters and secure minimum 2.5 CPGA to qualify for research thesis in 3 rd semester and 4 th semester that are comprised 6 credit hours.
For degree, student must earn minimum CGPA of 2.50 and have successfully completed research thesis.

BS Medical Physics
OVERVIEW
Medical Physics is an interdisciplinary field that applies physics principles to medicine, particularly in the diagnosis, imaging and treatment of human diseases. The proposed BS Medical Physics program is designed to equip students with a solid foundation in physics, biology and medical sciences, preparing them for careers in healthcare, research and academia (collaboration with local hospitals).
Objectives and Program Outcomes
Program Vision:
To be a leading program that equips students with the knowledge, skills and ethical foundation necessary to excel in the field of medical physics, ultimately advancing healthcare technology and improving patient outcomes globally.
Program Mission:
To educate and train students in the principles and applications of medical physics, empowering them to contribute effectively to healthcare through innovative technology, research and ethical practice.
Program Objective:
The BS Medical Physics program objectives are to:

chunks.title: Road Map of BS Medical Physics

Provide students with a comprehensive understanding of physics principles as applied to medical imaging, radiation therapy, and other healthcare technologies.

Provide an opportunity for advanced studies in Medical Physics, Nuclear Medicine, Radiological Physics, Biomedical Engineering or related graduate programs.

chunks.title: MSAI Overview
chunks.text:
MSAI Overview – Lahore Garrison University
Programme overview and scope:

chunks.title: MSAI Overview
chunks.text: The research and development in interdisciplinary domains of artificial intelligence applications can solve many daily routine problems and improve our lifestyle by offering products in many domains such as smart homes, smart cities, smart agriculture, smart vehicles, business intelligence, smart surveillance, and smart healthcare. To meet these objectives, it is required to equip our upcoming students with the latest technologies and essential skills in AI covering both theory and practical aspects. The MS AI programme should enable the students to learn essential theoretical knowledge and learn marketable skills in AI. This programme offers advanced courses to understand core concepts of machine learning as well as specialized elective courses to train students with state-of-the-art skills in AI. This programme will not only produce AI-trained scientists and engineers who can meet the requirements of AI and data science in the Pakistani industry/globally but also it will help the students who like to start a research-based career and planning to enroll in a PhD programme.

chunks.title: MSAI Overview
chunks.text:
Programme Objectives:
The main objectives of the MSAI degree programme are:
⦁ To broaden the academic and professional perspectives of students through a rigorous curriculum focused on core and emerging areas of artificial intelligence.
⦁ To cultivate students’ abilities to think critically and solve complex problems, enabling them to design and implement intelligent business decisions and innovative AI-driven solutions for real-world challenges.
⦁ To equip students with advanced computational, statistical, and machine learning techniques for processing and analyzing large, complex datasets, preparing them for data-centric roles in AI.
⦁ To develop professionals who can effectively meet the evolving demands of both national and international markets for artificial intelligence products, solutions, and expertise.
⦁ To foster a research-oriented mindset, empowering students to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in artificial intelligence and enabling them to pursue doctoral studies and advanced research in AI and allied technologies.
Learning Outcomes:

chunks.title: MSAI Overview
chunks.text:
After the completion of degree students will be able:
⦁ Comprehensive Knowledge: To demonstrate a deep understanding of specialized areas in Artificial Intelligence, fostering an expanded vision of the field’s potential applications and implications.
⦁ Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: To exhibit strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex and non-trivial challenges in AI, applying innovative approaches.
⦁ Practical Application: To apply advanced AI tools and techniques to develop solutions with strategic value, addressing key societal and industrial needs.
⦁ Research Excellence: To conduct impactful research in challenging areas of AI, contributing novel insights and advancements to the field.
⦁ Academic Readiness: To demonstrate preparedness for advanced studies, including doctoral programs, in Artificial Intelligence and related domains at globally renowned institutions.
.
